_comment: Corrections from the MRI's 'Errata BLS 4.0' (Stand August 2026), applied by scripts/import-bls-foods.mjs when the seed is generated. The MRI implements all of them with BLS 4.1; until then these values are, in its words, maßgeblich. Keyed by BLS code; 'micros' overrides single keys of ingredient_nutrition.micros, 'nutrition: null' imports the food without a nutrition row. The OLSAC energy correction (erratum §3) is a rule, not a per-food value, and lives in scripts/lib/bls.mjs.
